observationsNotFindings.observation: The draft writes 'naming parent of G32 is join-fx-gate-naming.v2 (D-169)'. The string join-fx-gate-naming.v2 occurs zero times in COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md; the D-169 entry names DR-G32 and the harness path and says only 'Does not record join-fx-gate-naming.v1' and 'D-086 successor in the same act'. The attribution resolves through D-169's pinned three-limb candidate g32-three-limb-act.v2.json (digest 8a641238… reproduces against the D-169 entry), whose basedOn.namingV2 cites join-fx-gate-naming.v2.json at 53303175… (live digest reproduces) as 'that same-act naming after JFXG-V1-B1', and through G32 occupancy v3 (D-209, dual ACCEPT 0/0), whose purpose pins join-fx-gate-naming.v2 'as the accepted naming successor consumed by D-169'. leftover-join.v12 basedOn.namingV2.role says the same ('Recorded as the D-169 D-086 limb').
observationsNotFindings.whyNotAFinding: The referent is unique and no byte contradicts the sentence; the only cost is one inference step from the COORD text to the pinned candidate, the same class as the naming v6 (D-145) shorthand the Stage A reviewer recorded as CLAUDE-DALJ-V12-OBS2 and that D-284 adopted at CONSENT. The prompt stipulates the wording. A later entry could write 'join-fx-gate-naming.v2 (the D-169 D-086 limb, via g32-three-limb-act.v2)' to remove the step. No change requested.
